title: I2S audio transceiver: TX and RX at once, master (bclk / wclk generated) or slave, I2S / left-justified / right-justified, 16 / 24 / 32-bit samples in 32-bit slots

regs.name: CFG
regs.desc: Configuration; a change re-synchronises the frame counters

fields.desc: 1: master (bclk_out = PCLK / 4, wclk_out = bclk / 64), 0: slave (bclk_in / wclk_in, synchronous to PCLK)

regs.name: TX
regs.desc: Stereo sample pair, LSB-aligned; taken at the start of the next frame (a frame without a pair sends zeros)

regs.name: RX
regs.desc: Received stereo pair (LSB-aligned, one per frame); reading the right word frees it

irqs.name: FSYNC_ERR
irqs.desc: slave mode: the bclk / wclk phase broke (e.g. a dropped bclk pulse); the core re-synchronises on the next wclk edge

notes: bclk_out / wclk_out (master clocks), bclk_in / wclk_in (slave clocks), sd_out and sd_in pass through unchanged. A frame is 64 bclk = 256 PCLK.
A pair arrives every frame, zeros included when nothing was sent, so RX must be read once per frame; a pair arriving with RX full is dropped (RX_OVF).
